items.item_text: Registered Nursing License (RN) in CA required.
Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (e.g. BSN) or equivalent education and experience and Master's degree in nursing or other-related field (e.g., MSN/MBA/MHA) required.
Minimum of three (3) years of nursing experience required.
Minimum two (2) years of leadership experience required.
Three (3) or more years Oncology experience preferred.

As our Director, Cancer Center Services, you will lead the Medical Oncology practice and support the day-to-day operations of our Oncology Service at Bakersfield Memorial Hospital in Bakersfield, CA. Are you looking to take your career to new heights as a leader in oncology and cancer care? Our Oncology service serves a large, diverse population here on the Central Valley of California. Our specialized oncology care team provides personalized, compassionate, expert care to our patients.

Every day, in collaboration with your team and in partnership across our many specialties, you will drive the development, continuous improvement, and promotion of quality standards of care while ensuring an excellent patient experience for all patients. You will also manage the finances of oncology services and partner with Philanthropy to develop funding opportunities for oncology services and cancer care.

To be successful in this role, you will need to be an experienced healthcare manager or director with a track record of success overseeing inpatient and outpatient oncology services. You must be competent and confident, with excellent one-on-one and group communication skills. Every interaction is an opportunity to share your knowledge and improve others' understanding of a patient’s needs.
We are offering relocation assistance to all hires who meet relocation eligibility requirements, and we are offering a sign-on bonus up to 10% of salary to fully qualified external hires.

Additional incentives for this Director of Cancer Center Services position include an annual performance-based bonus program, annual employer-funded retirement contribution (no employee contribution required), no-cost medical coverage for the employee, and a Flexible Time Away program.
